paper_title: Sparse Tiling Through Overlap Closures for Termination of String Rewriting
statement: Since our focus for the present paper is string rewriting, we also leave open the question of whether sparse tiling would be useful for termination of term rewriting.
context: Interesting open questions (that are independent of any implementation) are about the relation between sparse tilings of different widths, and between sparse tilings and other methods, e.g., matchbounds. Since our focus for the present paper is string rewriting, we also leave open the question of whether sparse tiling would be useful for termination of term rewriting.
